Sporting CP began to exert control, and their persistence paid off in the 34th minute when Francisco Petrasso tripped Luis Suarez in the box. With the hosts down to nine men, Sporting CP put the game beyond doubt in the 90th minute. Geovany Quenda scored the final goal with a precise left-footed finish after a brilliant setup by Maximiliano Araujo . The Primeira Liga clash on April 29, 2026 , provided a masterclass in late-game drama as Sporting CP and Tondela fought through a grueling encounter that defied all logic in its closing stages. Fans at the stadium witnessed a match where momentum shifted like the tide, ensuring the result remained in doubt until the very last second. A Tense Tactical Battle The match began with both sides feeling each other out, leading to a fragmented first half defined more by the referee’s whistle than goalmouth action. Sporting CP attempted to establish dominance early through Geovany Quenda and Geny Catamo , but Tondela remained disciplined, albeit at a cost. The visitors saw several players enter the book, with Rony Lopes and Pedro Henryque receiving yellow cards for rough challenges and unsportsmanlike conduct respectively. Sporting ’s Eduardo Quaresma also found himself cautioned just before the break, reflecting a physical half where clear-cut chances were a rarity. Suarez Breaks the Deadlock The second half saw a significant shift in energy, particularly after a triple substitution by the hosts in the 57th minute. The introduction of Trincao and Salvador Blopa proved inspired. In the 62nd minute, Trincao unlocked the defense with a precision key pass, allowing Salvador Blopa to square the ball for Luis Suarez . The striker made no mistake, firing home with his right foot to give Sporting CP a deserved 1-0 lead. The pressure continued to mount, and in the 78th minute, the lead was doubled under unfortunate circumstances for the visitors. A dangerous ball into the box resulted in Joao Silva inadvertently turning the ball into his own net, seemingly putting Sporting in total control. Stoppage-Time Insanity What followed in the final minutes will be remembered as one of the most chaotic sequences of the season. It began in the 91st minute when Giorgi Kochorashvili tripped Hugo Felix in the area, conceding a penalty. Makan Aiko stepped up for Tondela , but his effort was brilliantly parried by the goalkeeper. However, the reprieve for the hosts was short-lived. From the resulting corner delivered by Hugo Felix , Salvador Blopa went from hero to villain, slicing the ball into his own net to make it 2-1 and breathing life back into the away side. With the clock ticking deep into added time, Tondela threw everything forward in a desperate bid to find an equalizer. In the 94th minute, Hugo Felix once again proved to be the architect of the chaos, swinging in a perfect corner from the right. Cicero , who had come on as a late substitute, rose highest in a crowded penalty area to head the ball home, completing a stunning comeback to level the score at 2-2. Despite Sporting 's 64% possession and late attempts to find a winner in the final seconds, the points were shared in a match that perfectly illustrated the unpredictable nature of football.
